mapper.select: SELECT T1.SEQ_NO SEQ_NO, T1.SETTLE_SEQ_NO SETTLE_SEQ_NO, T1.SETTLE_TIME SETTLE_TIME, T1.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, T1.SETTLE_NUM SETTLE_NUM, T1.SETTLE_AMT SETTLE_AMT, T1.OPER_TYPE OPER_TYPE, T1.CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, T1.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, T1.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, T1.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, T1.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME, T2.FINPROD_NAME , T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, concat(concat(T3.BUSI_ACCT_NO,':'),T3.ACCT_NAME) operator FROM TRD_MANUAL_SETTLE_FLOW T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO T4 on T1.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = T4.SETTLE_SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON T4.ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO where T1.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = #{settleSeqNo} order by T1.SETTLE_TIME DESC
